description: Fork of exp428 (1.4983). Swap ONLY the LUT param group's optimizer from AdamW to LION (sign-of-momentum, betas=(0.9,0.99)). Non-LUT (unembed/tok_emb/temps/norms) stay AdamW. lut_lr=2e-4 chosen to match exp446's MEASURED realized Adam LUT lr (~2.2e-4) and LION's 'lr 3-10x smaller than Adam' guidance vs the 1e-3 nominal. Tests whether a full-magnitude sign step beats Adam's ~0.22x-damped step on LUTs.
